subject.title: Maintainer default quota is a shared policy pool; no per-user budgets or self-service keys

question: Should verified human assignment identities receive isolated budget subjects and be allowed to mint caller-bound proxy credentials, while service credentials retain shared policy accounting?
rationale: Current documentation intentionally assigns durable credential issuance to administrators, and changing both accounting identity and issuance authority requires an explicit product and security contract.

options.title: Split human and service identities
options.body: Give verified humans per-principal budget windows and constrained self-service keys while preserving shared accounting for service policies.

options.title: Isolate budgets only
options.body: Add per-principal human budget windows but retain administrator-only proxy-key issuance.

options.title: Keep the shared model
options.body: Preserve shared policy windows and administrator-managed credentials for every identity.

recommendation.title: Split human and service identities
recommendation.body: Give verified humans per-principal budget windows and constrained self-service keys while preserving shared accounting for service policies.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to current usage, budget, pricing, role-aware console behavior, and the production evaluation behind the request.
